items.title: Diblasio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: So I love Yusef. Yusef Lateef, his sound, I mean his tenor sound on those Cannonball things are just great.

ctx.x: But that’s what makes those people stand out, because you can’t say what it is. And to me that’s like the magic of it. You can only analyze things so far, at least in my opinion.

Well I think you can analyze, I think that’s all you can do is analyze it, and that’s okay and that’s good, but I think all that is in service of the sound that we like. And if we’re not listening a lot then we can really fall in love with the analysis. And you know, you write books on analysis. Half of them are mine. But it still doesn’t get you, when you hear it, the man didn’t do anything. He played an E. You know? And Bill Evans, who was telling me a story about it was Bill Evans birthday and a bunch of —…
